title: query_package_advisories request
description: One JSON object that names one exact version of one package in one ecosystem. The tool sends it to https://api.osv.dev/v1/query.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem name, written exactly as OSV writes it.

name.description: Package name as the ecosystem writes it, for example jinja2, @types/node, golang.org/x/net, org.slf4j:slf4j-api or symfony/http-kernel.

version.description: One exact version, for example 2.4.1, 1.0.0-beta.1 or v1.2.3. A range is not accepted.
